<decisions>
## Implementation Decisions

### Owner-Locked Scope Amendment

- Do not create or execute FACE-01 revision 23.
- Do not modify `FaceShapeWarpProvider`, the committed generated FACE-01 RED,
  the frozen `+16 Q16` semantic/protection contract, any threshold, source,
  public API, renderer, backend, `Warp.metal`, fixture, model, or dataset.
- A terminal `90-01-SUMMARY.md` may record only the owner-approved deferred
  disposition. It must state `promotion_eligible: false`, must not list
  FACE-01 under `requirements-completed`, and must not be represented as GREEN.
- Revise 90-03/04 to synchronize owner contracts and run bounded
  compatibility/boundary verification for one completed repair plus one
  deferred/partial field.
- Phase 95 must preserve the 65-output inventory, report seven active
  directions effective, and report `faceContourSmooth` deferred/partial.
- Phases 91–94 are timeboxed to one research pass, one independently checked
  plan, and at most two implementation attempts before an explicit owner
  repair/defer/stop decision.

### Locked Boundaries
- Preserve exactly 62 public parameter fields, five presets, 75 renderer cases,
  both public still-image facade signatures, and the current CPU/GPU contract.
- Do not change retained `Warp.metal`, add a Metal/GPU API/backend, add public
  controls, restore UI/Demo code, or introduce models, weights, datasets,
  network paths, realtime/video work, or device/commercial claims.
- Keep the exact established safety caps, neutral identity, request-local
  support ownership, per-control degradation, privacy-safe diagnostics, and
  source-safe collision behavior.
- Do not weaken Phase 89 semantic thresholds to make a repair pass and do not
  borrow another control's semantic support or behavior as a proxy.

</decisions>
